$comment: docs/296 phase 1 (req 13): three beats against the dogfood inner instance, which has no preview and no GitHub merge. Build the repo first: scripts/demo-video/make-demo-repo.sh /workspace/.inner-shipit/demo-video/demo-repo.git [proxyUrl]. The URL is written `file://localhost/…`, not `file:///…`. Measured: three runs completed with it; runs with `file:///` bounced home; the mechanism is not pinned down (Node normalises both forms alike). `proxyUrl` is the address that reaches the agent container (where proxy.mjs runs) from the `dev` service container: the agent container's IP on the session's Compose network, i.e. the one in the same /24 as the inner instance URL from `shipit service list` (`hostname -I`). `model` pins the take off the instance's default (an Anthropic subscription route that fails every turn there, planning#358) onto a route the dogfood install can actually run; pick one with quota left (the DeepSeek key answered 402 Insufficient Balance on 2026-09-08). `pace.typingCharsPerSecond` is the driver's typing rate; `pace.textCharsPerSecond` is the value to pass to the proxy as `--pace-chars-per-second` when replaying.
